name: Woodcut
description: Woodcut: the block cut away in wedges, so the marks widen as they run down.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; polygon { points: 2 0 14 0 8 100 5 100; fill: #000 } polygon { points: 26 0 40 0 32 100 28 100; fill: #000 } polygon { points: 52 0 68 0 58 100 53 100; fill: #000 } polygon { points: 78 0 96 0 84 100 78 100; fill: #000 }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; polygon { points: 2 0 14 0 8 100 5 100; fill: #000 } polygon { points: 26 0 40 0 32 100 28 100; fill: #000 } polygon { points: 52 0 68 0 58 100 53 100; fill: #000 } polygon { points: 78 0 96 0 84 100 78 100; fill: #000 }); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
